findings.body: Editing an approved section in the story's own worktree without committing it still allows `forge work` to commit its status and continue the old conversation. This comparison uses `task.show`, which reads only committed content (`src/forge/task.py:94–97`), while the task checkout can still contain the old approved document. The approval workflow already recognizes working-tree changes (`src/forge/approval.py:74–80`). Check the current document in the story's worktree before accepting its approval, and add a regression test with an uncommitted story edit.

findings.body: The supplied Functional check exercises a first build and approval refusals, but never exercises a later successful continuation or crash recovery. It therefore skips covered items 7 and 9. Exercise the continuation, change briefing and drift behavior, then stop-and-read recovery and the running-turn refusal through `forge work`; record the observed outcomes in the required commit-message paragraph. Saying the test suite passes does not supply the missing functional walkthrough.
